'''Dalton Iselen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Iselen was one of the managing partners of [[Naescorcom/Legends|Naescorcom]], a manufacturing company that was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. After the [[heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], uncovered a secret [[Believers|Believer]] lab beneath a Naescorcom facility on [[Ipsus]], the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]] introduced Iselen to them. He thanked them for their efforts and offered them a job developing a new security system for the facility.
